causa.esperar.desc: You waited. The base kept using air and power, and the shield had time to settle.
causa.redistribuir_energia.desc: You moved power from the batteries to another system. It helps there, but it leaves less energy for everything else.
causa.reparar.desc: The crew fixed a broken part. Repairs cost energy and tire the crew, but the base gets safer.
causa.subir_escudo.desc: You made the shield stronger. It blocks more radiation, but it uses a lot of energy.
causa.refugiarse.desc: The crew hid in the shelter. They were safe from radiation, but nobody looked after the air and water.
causa.salida_exterior.desc: An astronaut went outside to fix something. Outside there is more radiation and the suit uses air.
causa.ajustar_orbita.desc: The satellite changed height. Higher sees more of Mars, lower sees more detail, and moving costs battery.
causa.colocar_modulo.desc: The crew built a new module. Building costs energy and time, and the module helps a few moments later.
causa.enviar_telemetria.desc: The antenna sent data to Earth. It costs energy, and the answer takes several minutes to travel back.
causa.consumo.desc: Every moment the base uses power, air and water, even when you do nothing.
causa.tormenta.desc: Particles from the Sun hit the base. They wear down the shield and use up energy.
causa.simular.desc: You asked the Mathematician to test a choice before making it.
mala_suerte.micrometeorito.desc: A tiny space rock, smaller than a grain of sand but very fast, hit the base. It was bad luck, not your choice.
mala_suerte.fallo_panel.desc: A solar panel stopped working. It was bad luck, not your choice.
mala_suerte.fuga_agua.desc: A pipe started leaking water. It was bad luck, not your choice.
mala_suerte.tormenta_polvo.desc: Martian dust covered the solar panels, so they made less power. It was bad luck, not your choice.
ia.danada_por_radiacion.desc: Radiation can scramble computer chips. Iris may now give wrong numbers: check with the crew.
ia.sube_nivel.desc: You are doing great, so Iris gives fewer hints and lets you decide.
ia.baja_nivel.desc: Things got hard, so Iris came back to give more hints.
ia.reparada.desc: The Engineer fixed Iris. Her numbers match the gauges again.
insignia.equilibrio.desc: You ended with energy, life support and shielding all in good shape.
insignia.autonomia.desc: You played so well that Iris turned off her hints, and she never got damaged.
insignia.escudo_solar.desc: A solar storm came and your shielding never dropped too low.
insignia.mecanica.desc: Iris got damaged and you had her repaired.
insignia.calculo.desc: You tested a choice with the Mathematician before making it.
